name: What is a pre-hung door versus a slab door for installation?
description: A pre-hung door includes the door in its frame for easier installation, while a slab door is just the panel, requiring more fitting to an existing frame.

mainEntity.name: What is a pre-hung door versus a slab door for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A pre-hung door comes as a complete unit with the door already mounted in its frame, along with hinges and sometimes the threshold. This makes installation quicker and easier, especially for new construction or when replacing the entire frame. A slab door is just the door panel itself, without a frame or hardware. Slab doors are used when the existing frame is in good condition and only the door panel needs replacement, but they require more labor for fitting and hardware installation.
